advisor.reasoning: BOS currently 23-24°C (73-75°F) at 15:00Z with CLR sky and backing wind shifting ENE→E at 7-13kt. Current 14:55Z print of 24°C = 75.2°F already ties the cap. Curve forecast peaks at 76.7°F (hour 18-19Z), guidance ensemble 76.7-78.1°F, all well above 75°F ceiling. Quantized whole-°C METAR hides tenths; actual peak likely 75.2-77°F. SST 67.5°F suppresses marine surge somewhat but onshore flow at 10-13kt is not yet strong enough to pin temperature. Day is young; solar still active through ~20Z. Guidance G=+2 (77 vs 75 ceiling) is moderate but with current temp already at cap and 3-4 heating hours remaining, exceedance is highly probable.
advisor.watch: Wind shift to sustained ENE >15kt or temperature drop below 23°C by 16:00Z would signal marine suppression capping the day at or below 75°F
advisor.direction_guard: Downgraded from CONCUR: reasoning argues the day stays cool/capped, but this position pays only if the high EXCEEDS the cap. Inverted.
